subject: Bounded Language 1 front-door development checkpoint
claim: On the implementation host, the exact candidate Windows wrapper passed the frozen-fixture, descriptor, and value-front-end phases and reported 329 development cases in 235,533 ms. The no-argument 492-case qualification path was not executed by this run.

source.value: Git commit dd26af64ae9b1239987f42fafdd02f9d9ba1fe03 plus the exact candidate input identified in runs[0].inputs

limitations: This is one local Windows observation, not a stable performance threshold or a paired-host result.
The run used the host's existing valid native development caches where the invoked producers permit them; it is not a clean-machine timing.
The 163 qualification-only cases after phase 3 were intentionally not executed, and this result cannot support a Qualified claim.
The historical 2,761,285 ms complete-owner timing came from GitHub Actions run 33894696448 at an earlier qualified source commit and is used only as a baseline comparison.
